text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 1.4 billion pounds ($411 million) foreign investment on the Cairo stock exchange in the six months to October 17.
- Egypt's inflation has fallen to eight percent compared to 30 percent in 1990.
- The government will start immediate measures against smuggling of goods. Parliament decides to convene sessions to discuss the problem, which threatens Egyptian industry.
- President Hosni Mubarak will meet Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Sunday.

- French President Jacques Chirac starts his visit to the Middle East today as part of efforts to break an impasse in the Middle East peace process. He will visit Syria, Israel, Lebanon, Jordan, Palestinian self-rule areas and Egypt, where he will hold talks with President Hosnia Mubarak.
- Results will be announced today of an investigation into 19 terrorists from the Gama'a Islamiya group charged with assassinations.
